row.notes: Per-frame vehicle system. Loop 2 inserts each session vehicle's u8 index ([[veh+0x20]+0x58]+0xe8) into robin_hood map<u8,float> at obj+0x148 (keyvals obj+0x160; value = 0.25*sum of 4 per-wheel floats). The 26th entry forces the 32->64 rehash (max 25 at 32 buckets); B26h aborts in that rehash's free (heap error 0x16). Insert call at 0x142e909ee.
